titles.romaji: 3 Choume no Tama: Uchi no Tama Shirimasen ka?
titles.native: 3丁目のタマ うちのタマ知りませんか?

description:
The first season of 3 Choume no Tama: Uchi no Tama Shirimasenka?

Note: The 1993 TV series is a recut of the 7-episode OVA series 'Tama & Friends: 3 Choume Monogatari' omitting the first OVA, but adding 3 additional new episodes.
